name: That 70's Band

evidence.note: Band site: NY's leading 70s dance/disco/funk group playing to packed dance floors; lists Oct 3 Car Show LI at Tobay Beach.
Salt Shack artist page tags the band 'Dance' and calls it a high-energy dance band.
Artist bio repeats the 70s dance/disco/funk focus, for weddings and concerts.

dancing.notes: A disco and funk band that says it plays to packed dance floors every week, and beach venues file its shows under 'Dance'. Expect lots of freestyle dancing.

description: New York and Long Island '70s dance band covering disco and funk hits by Earth, Wind & Fire, Kool & the Gang, Donna Summer, Chic and the Bee Gees for concerts, weddings and dinner dances.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Disco crowds sometimes do partner hustle, but no evidence was found for this band, so only freestyle is listed. Oct 3 gig is the Tobay Beach car show.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current website, Facebook, Instagram, genres and description all confirmed; no description change needed. The site only works over http (https gives an SSL error). Phone and email are the band's own published booking contacts. The site gallery loads with scripts, so only one band photo (the gallery page header) could be taken; other site images are event flyers.

logo.alt: That 70's Band logo: chrome lettering with '70's' inside a mirror-ball circle, on black

photos.alt: That 70's Band's singers, horn players and percussionist performing on an outdoor bandshell stage at night, with the band logo on a speaker banner

evidence.note: Official site: 'NY's leading 70s dance/disco/funk' band, available for events, concerts and weddings; lists (631) 553-1221 and that70sbandlive@gmail.com; upcoming Long Island dates (Oyster Fest, East Northport, Moriches, Riverhead).
Contact page has a booking form and points to Facebook messenger at facebook.com/that70sbandlive.
Salt Shack (Babylon) event page links the band's Instagram, that70sbandny.
